chunks.subject: AP Research
chunks.title: Academic Paper exemplar — Sample H, 2/5
chunks.content: Sample H scored 2/5 (Report on Existing Knowledge with Simplistic Use of a Research Method). Topic: comparing the effectiveness of thrombolysis in frostbite treatment (a 'to what extent' comparison question). Despite a specific question, the method is used simplistically and the paper largely reports existing knowledge rather than building a supported new understanding. Illustrates the 2 band.
